## PR Type

- [ ] Editorial PR
- [ ] Claim change PR
- [ ] Engineering/research PR

## Editorial Scope

For editorial-only PRs:

- [ ] Prose only
- [ ] No generated tables/claims/summaries edited
- [ ] No numbers changed
- [ ] No citations added/removed unless requested
- [ ] No experiment interpretation changed
- [ ] `make paper-support` passes
- [ ] `make paper-pdf` passes

If any editorial-scope box cannot be checked, mark this as a claim change PR and
describe the changed claim, artifact, generated block, number, citation, or
interpretation below.

## Claim Change Scope

Required for claim change PRs:

- **Claim id**:
- **Artifact path**:
- **Regenerated command**:
- **Before/after scope**:
- **Interpretation rationale**:
